notes: Repository reconciliation 2026-09-21 against main c7ed9caf06bd44460a7717e4f419b51cf49792d4 confirms WU-011 is in progress: PR #118 reconciled its state and PRs #119-#122 added dataset-provenance, fail-closed provider-candidate provenance binding, a non-activating provider review contract, and an immutable activation-review audit registry. These changes do not authorize model training, paid compute, provider activation, deployment, or production routing. PHASE-000 remains complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through a VSN virtual microphone installed on a controlled Windows test machine. Its PortCls/WaveRT scheduler, capture-only INF/test package, InfVerif/Inf2Cat validation and installed-runtime smoke harness remain CI verified, but hosted CI is intentionally verification_required for a real installed endpoint; controlled endpoint enumeration, calling-app routing, hardware latency/jitter and release-signing evidence remain pending. WU-014 remains in progress and has advanced materially. PR #62 merged an owner-approved PostgreSQL-backed organization-membership persistence boundary with parameterized subject+organization lookup, fail-closed row validation, duplicate/corrupt-row rejection, migration constraints and API tests. PR #64 merged bounded node-postgres runtime wiring with exact dependency pins, optional VSN_POSTGRES_URL activation, production TLS enforcement, bounded pool/timeouts, secret-safe config validation, fail-closed no-database behavior and idempotent pool shutdown; API Validation and AI Native Quality Gates passed. No live database, database credential, seeded tenant/user or deployed migration is claimed. The trusted-principal resolver still rejects by default because no production identity provider/session verification mechanism is selected and verified, and a trusted browser organization/session source plus populated workspace repositories remain pending. WU-016 remains in progress and has also advanced. PR #63 merged a generic signed HTTPS alert-delivery adapter over the content-safe operational alert contract, with fixed allowlisted HTTPS targets, HMAC-SHA256 signatures, bounded payload/timeouts, redirect rejection and stable non-secret error surfaces; AI Native Quality Gates passed. This does not claim a configured external endpoint, secret, successful real alert delivery or complete SSRF defense; production DNS/egress policy remains required. Full admin analytics, durable usage/billing reconciliation and production provider activation also remain pending. WU-002, WU-011, WU-014 and WU-016 are the four evidence-backed in-progress work units. Multi-agent execution remains in degraded single-runtime mode because config/ai/agent-catalog.json has no verified attachable agents and config/coordination/supervisor-state.json has no live Supervisor. Eleven bounded workstreams and a max_parallel_agents budget of 11 are staged, but they must not be represented as active workers until real identities are attached and leased through the coordination protocol. AI-Native plan/flow reconciliation on 2026-09-21 records that owner approval for Apply Recommended GitHub Rules is complete; the remaining governance blocker is external/admin-capable server-side application plus authenticated verification, not user decision. AI-Native next-work reconciliation on 2026-09-21 keeps WU-002/MOD-002 in progress but records its completion-blocking controlled-Windows acceptance dependency in Issue #110. Because that remaining acceptance cannot execute in the current runtime, WU-014 is the highest-priority dependency-satisfied unblocked work unit in the active PHASE-001 and is the next valid product work unit when governance gates permit unrelated safe work.
